name: Banh phong tom Nam Can
summary: Bánh phồng tôm Năm Căn is the shrimp cracker of the fishing town on the road to the cape. Eat it as a crisp snack or carry a bag home.
origin: Năm Căn. Vietnam Airlines lists the Năm Căn cracker, and Nhân Dân lists bánh phồng tôm Mũi Cà Mau as a collective trademark.
howToEat: Eat it as a crisp, or carry a bag home.
seoTitle: Banh phong tom Nam Can — shrimp crackers
seoDescription: Bánh phồng tôm Năm Căn is the shrimp cracker from the fishing town on the way to the cape, a crisp snack and a bag to carry home.
